tables.name: Specialization
tables.description: A specialist part of the military force.

results.name: Mounted
results.description: A section of the military force is most effective while riding.

results.name: Engineering
results.description: A section of the military force uses knowledge of materials and structure to exploit enemy weaknesses or create their own advantages. They may also employ devices such as explosives or traps.

results.name: Berserker
results.description: A section of the military force is made up of warriors that hurl themselves fearlessly into the fray, terrifying defenders and punching holes in enemy lines.

results.name: Covert
results.description: A section of the military force is trained in subtlety, going behind enemy lines and accomplishing tasks unsuited to large groups.

results.name: Theatrics
results.description: A section of the military force uses display to distract enemy attention and sow chaos (such as starting strategically-placed fires).

results.name: Magical
results.description: A section of the military force is made up of magic-users, or arcane specialists are placed in every squad.

results.name: Biological
results.description: A section of the military force has expert knowledge of diseases and chemicals, manufacturing and distributing disruptive, or even deadly, munitions.

results.name: Calculation
results.description: A section of the military force are experts at analysis and coordination, increasing the efficiency of the entire force.

results.name: Unconventional
results.description: A section of the military force employs unorthodox thinking and methods, taking advantage of the enemy’s preconceived notions to achieve unexpected results.

results.name: Transport-Based
results.description: A section of the military force are trained in warfare from a particular type of craft (sailing vessels, airships, etc.).

results.name: Defensive
results.description: A section of the military force (or the entire force) is weighted towards strong defense as the best offense, favoring shields and unbreakable formations.
